atoms.exact_source_text: A new or refreshed Frill may create a low-stakes EMBODY opportunity.
atoms.normalized_claim: A new or refreshed Frill may create a low-stakes EMBODY opportunity.

atoms.exact_source_text: Beautification is a passive Home process driven by untasked Citizens.
atoms.normalized_claim: Beautification is a passive Home process driven by untasked Citizens.

atoms.exact_source_text: It advances a single Colony-wide clock, places minor cosmetic Frills at intervals, and may create temporary EMBODY opportunities.
atoms.normalized_claim: Beautification advances a single Colony-wide clock, places minor cosmetic Frills at intervals, and may create temporary EMBODY opportunities.

atoms.exact_source_text: It creates no Load, grants no Readiness, uses no Project slot, and does not alter Place use.
atoms.normalized_claim: Beautification creates no Load, grants no Readiness, uses no Project slot, and does not alter Place use.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Corridor is one continuous world.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Corridor is one continuous world.

atoms.exact_source_text: Home is its civic center;
atoms.normalized_claim: Home is the Corridor's civic center.

atoms.exact_source_text: Outposts are persistent footholds;
atoms.normalized_claim: Outposts are persistent footholds.

atoms.exact_source_text: the Metropolis is a recurring destination rather than a replacement settlement or endpoint.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Metropolis is a recurring destination rather than a replacement settlement or endpoint.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Corridor is a line of authored or programmatically assembled Median Reaches.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Corridor is a line of authored or programmatically assembled Median Reaches.

atoms.exact_source_text: Reaches may vary in biome while preserving plausible regional continuity rather than strict local geography.
atoms.normalized_claim: Reaches may vary in biome while preserving plausible regional continuity rather than strict local geography.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each Reach is approximately a long rectangle containing a central Median, two Highways, and two Margins.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each Reach is approximately a long rectangle containing a central Median, two Highways, and two Margins.

atoms.exact_source_text: Longitudinal movement uses the modified Longitudinal Crossing grammar.
atoms.normalized_claim: Longitudinal movement uses the modified Longitudinal Crossing grammar.

atoms.exact_source_text: Fog of War persists until exploration or Outpost establishment.
atoms.normalized_claim: Fog of War persists until exploration or Outpost establishment.

atoms.exact_source_text: Home appears as a shaded circle within its Median and does not consume an entire Reach.
atoms.normalized_claim: Home appears as a shaded circle within its Median and does not consume an entire Reach.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Corridor continues beyond the Ancestral Home and Rest-Stop Metropolis;
atoms.normalized_claim: The Corridor continues beyond the Ancestral Home and Rest-Stop Metropolis.

atoms.exact_source_text: neither is terminal.
atoms.normalized_claim: Neither the Ancestral Home nor the Rest-Stop Metropolis is terminal.

atoms.exact_source_text: Provisional geography places the Ancestral Home three Reaches downcorridor and the Rest-Stop Metropolis six Reaches upcorridor.
atoms.normalized_claim: Provisional geography places the Ancestral Home three Reaches downcorridor and the Rest-Stop Metropolis six Reaches upcorridor.

atoms.exact_source_text: Exact spacing remains adjustable.
atoms.normalized_claim: Exact spacing remains adjustable.

atoms.exact_source_text: Node is the blanket world category for all Resources and some Items.
atoms.normalized_claim: Node is the blanket world category for all Resources and some Items.

atoms.exact_source_text: Median Nodes tend toward Sustenance;
atoms.normalized_claim: Median Nodes tend toward Sustenance.

atoms.exact_source_text: Margin Nodes are mixed.
atoms.normalized_claim: Margin Nodes are mixed.

atoms.exact_source_text: Highway opportunities belong to Crossing and MEET rather than a generic Highway Node layer.
atoms.normalized_claim: Highway opportunities belong to Crossing and MEET rather than a generic Highway Node layer.

atoms.exact_source_text: Authored Reaches may cluster ordinary Nodes without introducing a separate site or cluster system.
atoms.normalized_claim: Authored Reaches may cluster ordinary Nodes without introducing a separate site or cluster system.

atoms.exact_source_text: Reach state uses the minimum useful vocabulary: Unknown, Explored, Outposted.
atoms.normalized_claim: Reach state uses the minimum useful vocabulary: Unknown, Explored, Outposted.

atoms.exact_source_text: TRAVEL reveals territory.
atoms.normalized_claim: TRAVEL reveals territory.

atoms.exact_source_text: Nodes open MEET.
atoms.normalized_claim: Nodes open MEET.

atoms.exact_source_text: There is no Study meter or Knowledge currency.
atoms.normalized_claim: There is no Study meter or Knowledge currency.

atoms.exact_source_text: An Outpost is a permanent Away installation within an explored Reach.
atoms.normalized_claim: An Outpost is a permanent Away installation within an explored Reach.

atoms.exact_source_text: It has no Residence and no permanent inhabitants.
atoms.normalized_claim: An Outpost has no Residence and no permanent inhabitants.

atoms.exact_source_text: It hosts Shelter and staging functions but is not a second Home or remotely managed settlement.
atoms.normalized_claim: An Outpost hosts Shelter and staging functions but is not a second Home or remotely managed settlement.
